Amarnath Yatra Begins with First Puja Amidst Security Preparations

The annual Amarnath Yatra has formally commenced with the first puja performed by the Lieutenant Governor in Jammu and Kashmir. The pilgrimage, set to begin on July 3rd, involves extensive security measures including surveillance cameras and mock drills. Preparations also include enhanced facilities for pilgrims, such as insurance coverage and tracking systems.
